name: How long does it take to install new bathroom flooring?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new bathroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom flooring installation project depends on several factors, including the size of the bathroom, the type of flooring material chosen, and the condition of the subfloor. A simple vinyl or tile installation in a small bathroom might take 1-2 days. If subfloor repairs, leveling, or custom layouts are needed, the project could extend to 3-5 days. Additionally, certain materials like tile require drying and curing time for grout and mortar, which adds to the overall timeline before the floor can be used.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom flooring installation typically takes 1-5 days, depending on bathroom size, flooring type, and subfloor condition.
